messages.subject: change in likelihood-model gev
parts:
There have been a minor change in the likelihood-model gev due to a bad
choice made years ago; see inla.doc("gev") for updated doc. the prior
is now defined on the shape-parameter \xi parameter directly. the
change is made in the testing-version of today.
